summary.text: Jesús "Chuy" García represents Illinois's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House and was sworn in on January 3, 2019.

paragraphs.text: Before Congress he served on the Cook County Board of Commissioners, as a Chicago alderman for the 22nd Ward, and as an Illinois state senator.
He was born in Los Pinos, in the Mexican state of Durango, immigrated to the United States with his family in 1965, and lives in Chicago's Little Village neighborhood.
